item.title: [ransomware] 6-Year Ransomware Campaign Targets Turkish Homes & SMBs
item.description: While enterprises breaches make more headlines, smaller incidents tend to be under-reported, if at all, allowing campaigns to last longer with less disruption.

item.title: [ransomware] Ransomware Attacks are on the Rise
item.description: Lockbit is by far this summer’s most prolific ransomware group, trailed by two offshoots of the Conti group.
